details.description:
Thousands of skulls scream their old grievances in unison.

@UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.journals.JournalEntry.jxn9bB1XhZTRpF65.JournalEntryPage.94wLkbfz0zc6czXz]{05. The Ossuary Wall}. Level 15 complex haunt that joins the skulltaker fight. Drop it for a Moderate threat (80 XP); at party level 18 raise it to level 17 (DCs +3).
details.disable: @Check[religion|dc:36] to recite the funeral rites of the Kellid dead (three successes required), or @Check[diplomacy|dc:39] or Kellid Lore to promise the bones their chieftain will be honoured (two successes). Destroying the skulltaker also ends the haunt.
details.reset: The haunt resets at the next dusk.
details.routine:
(1 action) The wall screams. Each living creature within the ring attempts a @Check[will|dc:36] save.

Critical Success No effect.

Success @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}, and the creature can't reduce its frightened value below 1 while inside the ring.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.
